summary: M.S. Computer Engineering from RIT with hands-on robotics systems and production C++ code. Built full-stack robotic arms with vision-guided grasping, kinematics pipelines, and real-time sensor integration. Experienced in hardware-software integration across Jetson, Arduino, and STM32 for motion control.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline using image stitching, wavelet denoising, and monocular depth estimation.
Deployed ZoeDepth depth estimation with ±8% error; designed custom wavelet bank achieving PSNR of 86.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove with ADXL345 accelerometers, Raspberry Pi, and Bluetooth for 3-DoF hand motion to HID command translation.
Implemented custom tap-detection algorithm resolving sensor jitter through software calibration.

experience.title: General Secretary, Robotics Club
bullets: Led 25-member robotics team across national competitions, owning mechanical design and AI/ML integration.
Designed and fabricated custom PCBs in EAGLE; implemented UART and I2C communication with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm with Vision-Guided Grasping (COFFIN)
bullets: Built full-stack voice-controlled pick-and-place system: Flutter mobile client, Flask edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller via WebSocket.
Engineered contact-aware grasping with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors, servo control, and 2-link inverse kinematics.
Optimized real-time perception: TensorRT YOLO (5.2× speedup to 10.9ms), faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s) achieving <12s voice-to-grasp latency.
Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials); designed multi-camera data collection pipeline for robot learning.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm Kinematics & Trajectory Planning
bullets: Derived DH tables and computed forward kinematics (0T6) for 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated in ROS 2 Humble.
Executed collision-free trajectories on physical UR5e; achieved <2mm AL5B repeatability over 10 trials.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Implemented custom CUDA C++ kernels with memory coalescing and constant memory, eliminating per-layer allocation.
Achieved 49.2ms execution (35% speedup) with identical classification accuracy.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret with Real-Time Control
bullets: Integrated YOLOv8 on Jetson with STM32 servo control via UART for real-time object tracking.
Implemented FreeRTOS with mutexes, VL53L0X ToF sensing, and interrupt-driven deterministic servo PWM.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
